subject.title: Control UI: multi-select sessions in the sidebar for batch archive/delete/group actions

question: Should the primary sessions sidebar support persistent multi-selection, and should the first release include read-state, grouping, archive, and delete or start with the existing batch-delete capability only?
rationale: Current source proves feasibility and an existing delete contract, but it does not define the desired complexity of primary navigation or the failure and mixed-state semantics for the other proposed actions.

options.title: Approve full typed batch UX
options.body: Implement accessible modifier selection and canonical aggregate results for all four action families before exposing them in the sidebar.

options.title: Start with batch delete
options.body: Ship selection using the established deleteMany path and defer read, group, and archive actions until their batch contracts are defined.

options.title: Keep sidebar single-select
options.body: Leave bulk management on the Sessions page and preserve the sidebar as a simpler navigation surface.

recommendation.title: Approve full typed batch UX
recommendation.body: Implement accessible modifier selection and canonical aggregate results for all four action families before exposing them in the sidebar.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter opened the proposal, the issue carries the protected maintainer label, and his recent merged work touches the same sidebar surface.
